worldcombat.skill.metronome.summary: Waggles a finger to stimulate itself, then randomly borrows and performs one of the borrowable moves implemented in the world.
After wagging for %1$s it borrows and performs one random move from every implemented move that can be borrowed (Metronome itself and other callers are not in the pool).
The stirred move can reach %1$s blocks; wagging again costs %2$s.
Current bias: %1$s. Near draws only from moves with range 6 or less, far only from moves with range 10 or more; when no candidate is usable it falls back to the full pool.
worldcombat.skill.metronome.preference.b: Full spectrum keeps any move; near draws only from close-range moves; far draws only from long-range moves. A bias narrows the pool, and falls back to the full pool when nothing fits.
The borrowed move uses Metronome's own cooldown and does not additionally spend the borrowed move's PP; an attack move can only come up when an enemy is in range, otherwise only self or ally moves can be drawn.
